usedFor: An incoming Twilio call opens a deal in HubSpot while the caller is still fresh.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incoming Call” in Twilio, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It is pushed as a call arrives, and an inbound call is a clear buying signal.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the ID of an existing deal, so it cannot start from a new call.
